llm: PROGRESS AND ISSUE: Successfully identified and began converting replicated signals to pipesignals. Converted signbit successfully. Started converting imm31 but encountered multiple assignment error because imm31 is assigned in both shared and separate generate blocks, but TLV requires only one $$ assignment per pipesignal. NEXT STEPS: Need to consolidate multiple assignments into single conditional assignment, or handle replicated signals more systematically. The fundamental challenge is that signals declared at outer generate level but assigned in multiple inner generate blocks need special handling for TLV conversion.
